reviewNotes: Four branches from the complete five-piece physical-board setup Black Kc5/Ne8/h7 versus White Ke5/g6. Only h6 wins. The h6/Ke6/Kd4/Kf7/Ke5/Kxe8/Kf6 knight sacrifice and h6 king-chase representative remain Black wins. h5 gives a drawn promotion race; hxg6 lets White catch the remaining pawn. Captions name Kf5 after hxg6, but the actual physical diagram supports Kf4: Kf5 would enter the g6 pawn’s attack. The correction and independently selected replies are disclosed.

So by exclusion, the winning move is the more patient H6. This time if the king tries to reach the pawn, black needs to be very precise and it's going to chase the king with his own king.
